text: ちゃんと　くさむら　はいって　さがして　みろ！

structure.jp: ちゃんと　くさむら　はいって
structure.en: go properly into the tall grass and

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て form means giving something a try; みろ is the rough order form. さがして みろ = 'try searching!'

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. はいって = 'go in and'.

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: The ろ ending is a blunt order, used by someone talking down to you. さがして みろ = 'go and look!'
